title: reKolor ink palette
description: The inks an image can be printed with, as a JSON object: each key is an ink's name and each value its color. Key order matters: when two inks are equally near a color, the earlier one wins. A name containing "non-palette" (such as "Pure White (non-palette)") marks a color that isn't a real ink. Used by the web app (Download palette / Upload palette…) and the CLI (--palette); palettes/pantone.json is the built-in palette.

propertyNames.description: The ink's name, as configs (*.palettes.toml) refer to it.

additionalProperties.description: One ink. Keys other than rgb are allowed and ignored.

rgb.description: The ink's color as 8-bit sRGB: red, green, blue.
